case_name: Yelavarthi Santha Lakshmi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Yelavarthi Santha Lakshmi — daughter, seeking cancellation of family member certificate issued in favour of fifth respondent
parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Andhra Pradesh — government authorities, issuing the family member certificate

facts_of_case: Petitioner's mother died in 1991. Petitioner was adopted by step-mother Syamala and brought up by her. Petitioner seeks cancellation of family member certificate issued to fifth respondent, who is a family friend of petitioner's mother.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the public authority to follow the procedure prescribed under G.O.Ms.No.145 dated 25.04.2015 and consider objections before issuing a family member certificate.
legal_principles.held: In those circumstances, the petitioner made a representation to the second respondent/District collector on 13.09.2019 to cancel the family member certificate issued by the fourth respondent/Tahsildar in favour of the fifth respondent and requested to launch prosecution against the fifth respondent for giving false declaration before the public authority.

legal_principles.principle: A family member certificate cannot be issued without considering the objections and following the prescribed procedure.
legal_principles.held: The inaction of the respondents in not considering the representation of this petitioner is illegal and arbitrary.

outcome.final_order: The writ petition is allowed. The respondents are directed to cancel the family member certificate issued in favour of the fifth respondent.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for property dispute
